extracted.intended_audience: creative professionals, design and advertising agencies, entrants and followers of the D&AD Awards

rubrics_metrics.description: Top companies / Top individuals / Top countries — table headings include Rank, Name/Country, Winning Entries, Points
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rankings are reported using 'Winning Entries' and 'Points' as the metrics for ordering — used to identify top-performing companies, individuals and countries in the awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: D&AD Trend Report 2025
rubrics_metrics.description: D&AD Trend Report 2025: 'Dive into the trends that dominated the D&AD Pencil-winning work in 2025. This report highlights insights from the jury rooms and the work presented, while also reflecting the broader patterns of change in the world.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A report summarising jury insights and trends across winning work; the page notes you must sign into a D&AD account to download the report for free.
